Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class ReleaseState

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.ReleaseState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ReleaseState extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable model-explicit station snapshot. EOS-backed factories use total mass divided by thermodynamic volume; analytical models must declare their alternative property basis.

  • Method Details

    • fromFluid

      public static ReleaseState fromFluid(SystemInterface fluid, double velocityMs)
      Snapshots an initialized fluid without flashing or modifying it.
      Parameters:
      fluid - initialized, equilibrated station state
      velocityMs - axial velocity in m/s
      Returns:
      immutable state
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for nonpositive pressure, temperature or inventory
      IllegalStateException - for nonfinite properties or unclosed fractions

    • idealGas

      static ReleaseState idealGas(SystemInterface compositionReference, double pressurePa, double temperatureK, double densityKgM3, double enthalpyJkg, double entropyJkgK, double velocityMs)
      Creates an analytical ideal-gas station while retaining the supplied overall composition.

      Package-private by design: release models, rather than callers, own the property basis of a station.
